modified_caption: The bar chart illustrates the average rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation. The vertical axis contains the categories labeled 'Ours' and 'Standard,' while the horizontal axis represents the percentage composition. Each bar is divided into three segments, with colors representing different categories: blue for 'Context,' orange for 'Generated Response,' and green for 'Other.' The 'Ours' bar is composed of approximately 60.6% Context (blue), 31.7% Generated Response (orange), and 7.7% Other (green). The 'Standard' bar consists of approximately 23.6% Context (blue), 41.1% Generated Response (orange), and 35.3% Other (green). Notably, the 'Standard' model demonstrates a significant decline in attention to Context compared to the 'Ours' model, while the attention to Other increases substantially. This suggests that the 'Standard' model prioritizes system prompts over contextual information during generation.
